rationale: A prime-office K-REIT trading near its book NAV while its own filed appraisals carry the portfolio ~800bn above carrying value is valued on the appraisal-adjusted net asset envelope, with the discount explained by leverage and the 2026-2027 refinancing wall rather than asset quality.

hypotheses.statement: Appraisal-adjusted NAV of ~1,247bn attributable (9,986/share) is real as filed Level-3 fair values (3,794.5bn vs 2,992.9bn carrying) hold through the refinancing cycle
causal_chain: Seoul prime-office occupancy filed at 96.8% portfolio average
appraised fair value 3,794.5bn over 2,992.9bn carrying value
kill_conditions: refinancing of the ~1,011bn current-portion debt fails or reprices above rental yield
appraisal values are cut in the next annual report's fair-value note
next_checks: 2026.09 반기보고서 차입금 주석 - 전단채·사모사채·숭례 트랜치 차환 조건

context_strength_linkage.not_applicable_reason: No non-obvious environment-to-strength connection is observable in the collected evidence beyond the declared NAV thesis.
